animatedProofs.format: GIF on solid #10141B review background; proof-only, not a runtime asset
variants: 32x32 logical reduction enlarged to 256x256 with nearest-neighbor for inspection
animatedProofs.enemyMovementOmitted: The current enemy has no gameplay movement capability; no animated movement preview is emitted to avoid implying an unsupported behavior.

generation.note: Model, version, and seed were not exposed by the tool and are not inferred.

processing: Copied approved actor masters byte-for-byte into proof sources.
Generated one three-pose chroma strip per actor and semantic state.
Removed sampled border chroma with the installed imagegen remove_chroma_key.py helper using --auto-key border --soft-matte --transparent-threshold 12 --opaque-threshold 220 --despill.
Split each 1536x1024 strip into three equal 512x1024 source panels.
Computed one conservative global scale per actor from the tallest upright alpha bound so no upright frame touched the top edge.
Centered every alpha bound horizontally on x=128 and aligned its bottom to master y=210 on a 256x256 RGBA canvas.
Downsampled review images with Lanczos to 32, 22, 16, and 14 pixels.
Composited proofs on #10141B, #F4F0E8, #FF00FF, grayscale, and marked cell-contact panels.
Computed SHA-256 for all files in SHA256SUMS.txt.

knownLimitations: AI edits repaint pixels beyond the intended articulated pose changes; identity preservation is visual, not pixel-exact.
Player movement is 188 px high versus 198 px for the approved static and reads slightly smaller.
Enemy center idle silhouette IoU versus approved static is 0.7473 with common-area RGB MAE 35.049/255.
Enemy movement alpha width varies from 95 to 123 px, which may read as scale/silhouette breathing.
Enemy first hit pose resembles a guarded/attack pose, weakening semantic separation.
No runtime playback or cancellation behavior was changed or tested with these sheets because this gate is proof-only.
